part5.q: The new policy ___ already clarifies the guidelines for remote work.
part5.explain: ‘already’는 조동사 뒤에 위치해야 하므로 ‘has already’가 올바른 형태입니다.

part5.q: Our project manager ___ will soon announce the next phase.
part5.explain: ‘soon’은 조동사 ‘will’ 뒤에 와야 하므로 ‘will soon’이 맞습니다.

part5.q: The marketing team ___ frequently updates the website with new content.
part5.explain: ‘frequently’는 조동사 ‘does’ 뒤에 위치해 ‘does frequently’가 올바른 형태입니다.

part5.q: The supplier ___ always delivers the parts on time.
The manager ___ usually arrives early for meetings.

passage.title: Upcoming Product Launch Meeting
passage.body:
From: Emily Chen <echen@globaltech.com>
To: All Department Heads
Subject: Product Launch Coordination Meeting

Dear Team,

Please review the schedule below for the product launch coordination meeting next week. Attendance is mandatory for all department heads. If you have any conflicts, let me know by Tuesday.

--- Schedule ---
Monday, March 12
09:00 – 09:30   Opening remarks by CEO
09:30 – 10:15   Marketing presentation
10:15 – 10:30   Coffee break
10:30 – 12:00   Sales strategy discussion
12:00 – 13:00   Lunch (off-site)
13:00 – 14:30   Engineering update
14:30 – 15:00   Q&A session
15:00 – 15:15   Closing remarks

We look forward to a productive meeting.

Best,
Emily
